truth (issue #1118): the waiver of the per-path WARNs is the one of the module-wide FAIL: a non-empty
persistence: line in MODULE-MAP.md. A handler with no save path and a stopped() that cancels without a flush
give no row in a module that declares it.
-- args --
@DIR@/Mod
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- Mod/MODULE-MAP.md --
# Mod module map

persistence: the control module's ConfigSaveScheduler saves the linked slots
-- Mod/Mod-ux/src/com/x/ux/BDashServlet.java --
package com.x.ux;
public final class BDashServlet extends BWebServlet {
  void requestSave() {
    saveTicket = Clock.schedule(station, delay, BStation.save, null);
  }
  void doSetpoint(BComponent point, BValue v, Context cx) {
    point.set("out", v, cx);
    requestSave();
  }
  void doMode(BComponent point, BValue v, Context cx) {
    point.set("mode", v, cx);
  }
  @Override public void stopped() throws Exception {
    saveTicket.cancel();
  }
}
